nativeHandoff.remainingBoundary: Official jarvis.exe/WebView evidence must still prove cold auto-connect, a naturally scheduled refresh after at least 300000ms, an honest managed-runtime disconnect, automatic reconnect, and exact qualified-route restoration in one controlled acceptance sequence.
nativeHandoff.safeDisconnectBoundary: Use only a documented repository-owned managed-runtime lifecycle control already authorized to the native owner, or observe a genuine managed disconnect. Do not kill or adopt arbitrary processes, alter credentials, use developer state injection, or claim a restart as reconnect proof. If no safe within-session disconnect mechanism exists, leave the transition pending and record that exact blocker.

requiredTransitions.acceptance: From an official jarvis.exe-owned WebView/profile cold start, current-session OpenCode becomes authenticated and exposes live qualified model rows without manual connect or refresh.
A second authenticated catalog verification completes at least 300000ms after the baseline without a manual refresh, while the exact account and qualified routes remain stable.
A genuine supported within-session managed-runtime disconnect makes current live authority unavailable without promoting cached or static fallback rows to executable authority.
The same app session automatically re-detects and re-attests OpenCode after the supported runtime recovers, without manual refresh, credential mutation, or provider substitution.
The ordered set of exact provider-qualified live model routes after reconnect matches the pre-disconnect set, and no random disappearance or replacement route is observed.
